job.job_description:
WE ARE HIRING FOR MULTIPLE POSITIONS




Location: Pan India
Experience: 5+ Years (Role Dependent)
Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred




POSITION 1: AI ENGINEER / AI/ML ENGINEER / GEN AI ENGINEER
Experience: 5+ Years | Location: Pan India

About the Role:
We are seeking talented AI Engineers to work on cutting-edge AI/ML projects involving Large Language Models, Generative AI, and modern AI frameworks.

Key Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models and solutions
• Build and optimize LLM-based applications using LangChain
• Implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations
• Develop RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pipelines
• Work with vector databases and embedding models
• Fine-tune and optimize large language models
• Build end-to-end ML pipelines from data collection to deployment
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams on AI product development
• Stay updated with latest AI/ML research and implement best practices

Required Skills:
• 5+ years of experience in AI/ML development
• Strong proficiency in Python programming
• Hands-on experience with LLMs (GPT, Llama, Claude, etc.)
• Expertise in LangChain framework
• Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol)
• Knowledge of prompt engineering and fine-tuning techniques
• Experience with RAG architectures and vector databases
• Familiarity with deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch)
• Strong understanding of NLP concepts







POSITION 2: AI LEAD
Experience: 5+ Years (with 2+ years leadership) | Location: Pan India

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead and mentor a team of AI/ML engineers
• Define technical architecture for AI/ML solutions
• Drive adoption of Gen AI, LLM, LangChain, and MCP technologies
• Collaborate with product, business, and engineering stakeholders
• Establish best practices for AI development and deployment
• Manage project timelines and deliverables
• Hire, train, and develop AI talent
• Represent the team in technical discussions with clients/leadership

Required Skills:
• 5+ years of hands-on AI/ML development experience
• 2+ years of team leadership experience
• Expert-level Python programming
• Deep expertise in LLMs, LangChain, and MCP
• Experience with Gen AI application development
• Strong understanding of ML algorithms and deep learning
• Excellent communication and leadership skills




POSITION 3: AI ARCHITECT
Experience: 5+ Years (with architecture experience) | Location: Pan India

Key Responsibilities:
• Design end-to-end AI/ML architecture for enterprise solutions
• Define reference architectures for Gen AI, LLM, and RAG systems
• Establish AI technology standards and best practices
• Evaluate and select AI tools, frameworks, and platforms
• Design scalable, secure, and cost-effective AI systems
• Lead technical discussions with clients and stakeholders
• Ensure AI solutions meet performance, security, and compliance requirements

Required Skills:
• 5+ years of experience in AI/ML with architecture focus
• Expert-level knowledge of Python and AI/ML frameworks
• Deep expertise in LLMs, LangChain, and MCP
• Experience designing Gen AI solutions at enterprise scale
• Strong understanding of system design and distributed systems
• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
job.location: Hybrid - Pune, Delhi / NCR, Mumbai (All Areas)
